title: Fake "Bonus Vacanze" from Italy Revenue Agency steals personal data
content_md:
Fake "Bonus Vacanze" (Holiday Bonus) from Italy Agenzia delle Entrate steals personal data. CERT-AGID warns of a phishing campaign impersonating the Italian Revenue Agency holiday bonus program to harvest personal information. https://cert-agid.gov.it/news/falso-bonus-vacanze-dellagenzia-delle-entrate-ruba-dati-personali/

via Mastodon https://cert-agid.gov.it/news/falso-bonus-vacanze-dellagenzia-delle-entrate-ruba-dati-personali/
exclude_reason: Regional Italian phishing campaign, low global impact
